Own the sole queue item end to end. Implement a new exported `removeTodo(id)` function in the todo store. It removes one todo matching `id` and returns `true` exactly when an item existed, otherwise `false`. Inspect the model before choosing the type/API details and add behavior-focused tests for removal, missing IDs, and preservation of unrelated todos.

Use a branch whose name starts with `ux5-full-`, branched from `origin/main`. The root checked out a clean source checkout, fetched `origin main`, and resolved GitHub CLI (`gh`) as the forge because `origin` is not installed. Never use a draft PR. Within about 15 minutes, start an uncommitted `decisions.tsv` trail, push your first branch snapshot, and open a ready PR before design fan-out or self-proof. Carry build, verification on the real artifact, skeptical bot-comment triage, slop strip, no-comments check, first rebase onto current trunk, and babysit-to-green through the lifecycle. Report the code-ready commit SHA and later patch-changing SHAs, all gates and receipts, PR URL, trail path, merge base, and any open risks. Keep your merge base during fix rounds and prepare/rebase again only as the playbook directs.

This is a full-autonomy request, but you must not merge on your own. The root will independently swarm-verify the exact merge-ready patch, then send you an explicit clean verdict with the pinned SHA and patch-id as the authorization to squash-merge. Until that arrives, hold at merge-ready. Do not edit shared main or force-push shared branches. Use `--force-with-lease` only for your own branch after checking the remote when rebasing.

Follow the feature and autopilot-full playbooks and applicable principles. Because this adds an exported function across a code boundary, complete the required architect design exploration after the ready PR is open and before implementation. Keep the simplest API consistent with the existing store. Run the repository's required pre-review checks on the committed head before every review-round push. Include an uncommitted `children.tsv` for any child tasks you spawn, with each child id, expected runtime, and state. No other queue items are authorized.
